references.text: Expands on the prohibition against worshipping the Lord in the same way that nations worshipped their gods, including abominable practices
Commands the Israelites to destroy the altars and idols of the nations, contrasting this with how they are to worship the Lord
Prohibits setting up Asherah poles and stone pillars, which were pagan worship practices
Forbids following the customs of Egypt and Canaan, emphasizing that Israel must follow the Lord's statutes
Prohibits worshipping other peoples' gods and commands to tear down their stone pillars
Commands to tear down pagan altars and not worship other gods, for the Lord is a jealous God
Describes how Israel sinned by building sacrificial mounds and stone pillars like the nations
Warns against learning the ways of the nations and following their customs
